resource.name: exchange-rate-service
resource.description: Supplies real-time exchange rates between world currencies, used to convert amounts and to list the supported currencies.

suggestions.name: Open Exchange Rates
suggestions.description: Rates for 170+ currencies updated frequently; API key required, free tier has a USD base only.

suggestions.name: ExchangeRate-API
suggestions.description: Simple pair-conversion endpoint with an API key; free tier updates daily.

suggestions.name: Frankfurter
suggestions.description: Free, keyless, European Central Bank reference rates for about 30 currencies, updated on working days.

suggestions.name: Fixer
suggestions.description: Commercial rates API with an API key; paid plans for real-time updates.
